audit.whatIsWrong: Hammer Shock is called a 'knockup' in three places — it is not. Riot: 'Poppy swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that will slow enemies and explode after a delay.' The early text also invents the name 'Heroic Charging' for Heroic Charge. And nothing says that Steadfast Presence GROUNDS you after it stops a dash.
audit.why: The grounding is the whole matchup. Riot: 'If a dash is stopped, the enemy is slowed and GROUNDED.' So a cancelled Skip 'n Slash is not just a wasted dash — you cannot cast it again for the duration, which is why you die to the wall stun that follows. And Steadfast Presence is 20 seconds at rank 1, so baiting it out is worth an entire trade window.
audit.corrected: Knock-up removed in favour of the delayed slow zone, the real ability name used, and the grounding plus the 20-second cooldown stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart gives Gwen Level 1 while whys[0] says Poppy's W cancels her dash and her Q wins the trade, and gives her Level 2 as even while whys[1] says 'she still out-stats a mist-less Gwen'.
audit.why: Gwen loses this lane at 45.38%, her worst matchup in this slice. Her only genuine window is level 6 through her first item.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 and 2 set to Poppy in both layers; Level 6 left with Gwen.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait the W down before you ever commit your E' with no idea how long that buys.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence is 20/18/16/14/12s — twenty seconds at rank 1 and still twelve at rank 5. Heroic Charge is 14s, Hammer Shock 8s, Keeper's Verdict 140s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the whys, spikes, mid and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says her defensive stats scale with being low.
audit.why: Steadfast Presence passively grants armour and MR that INCREASE as she drops in health, so the last third of her health bar is the most expensive part — the opposite of how a %-max-HP kit usually reads a fight.

edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops your E dash AND grounds you, and Hammer Shock's slow zone wins the trade while you have no mist.

edits.before: She still out-stats a mist-less Gwen and can E you into the wall behind for a stun — last-hit, don't trade.
edits.after: She still out-stats a mist-less Gwen and can Heroic Charge you into the wall behind for a stun — last-hit, not trade.

edits.before: Her passive shield and Q out-sustain your cone-Q poke; you can't punish her without untargetability yet.
edits.after: Her buckler shield and Hammer Shock out-sustain your cone poke; without untargetability you cannot punish her.

edits.before: Hold W Steadfast Presence to cancel your E dash and slow you out of reposition range
edits.after: Hold Steadfast Presence (20s) to stop your E dash, ground you, and slow you out of range

edits.before: Poppy's W Steadfast Presence cancels your E dash mid-air and her Q knockup wins the short trade — she owns the levels before you have Hallowed Mist to hide in.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence stops your E dash and GROUNDS you, so there is no recast, and Hammer Shock's delayed slow zone wins the short trade — she owns these levels.

edits.before: Poppy owns the early outright — her W Steadfast Presence cancels your E dash the instant you try to reposition, and her Q knockup plus passive shield win the short trade levels 1-3 while you have no Hallowed Mist to hide in. Do not walk up to throw a cone Q she can answer by E Heroic Charging you into the wall behind you. Last-hit at max Q range, eat minimal poke, and wait for the level where untargetability exists. The upside: your passive Thousand Cuts still chips her percent-max-HP for free any time she greeds a trade.
edits.after: Poppy owns the early outright — Steadfast Presence stops your E dash the instant you reposition and GROUNDS you afterwards, so you cannot recast it, and Hammer Shock's slow zone plus her buckler shield win the short trade while you have no Hallowed Mist. Do not walk up to throw a cone Q she can answer with Heroic Charge into the wall behind you. Last-hit at max Q range and wait for the level where untargetability exists. The upside: A Thousand Cuts still chips her percent-max-HP any time she greeds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay hers — you are a melee whose only gap-close gets wall-stunned, so farm and respect E Heroic Charge near terrain. At 6 it tilts your way: drop Hallowed Mist as her E or R commits so the follow-up whiffs, slow her with Needlework, and let your ability-healing out-grind her short trades while Snip Snip's true-damage center snip ignores her armor. Bait the W down before you ever commit your E into her.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay hers — you are a melee whose only gap-close gets stopped, grounded and then wall-stunned, so farm and respect Heroic Charge (14s) near terrain. At 6 it tilts: drop Hallowed Mist as her E or R commits so the follow-up whiffs, slow her with Needlework, and let your healing out-grind her while the true-damage centre ignores her armour. Bait Steadfast Presence first — at rank 1 it is 20 seconds, and that is your whole window.

edits.before: Track Poppy's Heroic Charge: Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. When it is down — Snip her in your mist.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence (20s) stops your dash and GROUNDS you — no recast. Bait it before you ever E in.

edits.before: - Poppy Heroic Charge: matchup-defining — Wall-pin stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Steadfast Presence (W): 20/18/16/14/12s — stops dashes and grounds you, and its passive resists grow as she drops low. - Heroic Charge (E): 14s, stun only into a wall. - Hammer Shock: 8s. - Keeper's Verdict: 140s.

notes: The kit file gives Keeper's Verdict derived flags for grounding and untargetable, and Hammer Shock a grounding flag, none of which appear in Riot's descriptions — I did not assert any of them. The confirmed grounding is on Steadfast Presence, where Riot states it explicitly.
